evidence.title: nxui — 243+ Animated, Copy-Paste UI Components for Vue

name: nxui
summary: Docs for nxui, a free MIT collection of 243+ animated Vue 3 components installed with a shadcn-vue command or copied by hand.
description: Introduction page of the nxui documentation: a Tailwind CSS and motion-v component collection for Vue 3 and Nuxt 4. The registry ships 241 components across 8 categories (text animations, backgrounds, hero backgrounds, visual effects, buttons, animations, shaders, general components), each installable in one shadcn-vue command with dark mode and no added runtime dependencies, or copied by hand from the docs.
contains: 243+ copy-paste animated Vue components (registry: 241 across 8 categories)
install in one shadcn-vue command; source copied into your repo, no runtime dependency
built with Vue 3, Nuxt 4, Tailwind CSS v4, motion-v, VueUse, reka-ui
dark mode out of the box; MIT, free forever
live demos and copyable source on the docs site
